connection_to_fm_cuadro.GSE334369_lps_response: IL1B blunted in FM vs HC (p=0.055), IL6/CXCL8/TNFAIP3 blunted (p<0.05)
connection_to_fm_cuadro.cross_synthesis: Same cells respond differently to stress: monocytes UP-regulate IL1B with exercise stress (GSE324210); neutrophils show BLUNTED IL1B/IL6/CXCL8 LPS responses in FM (GSE334369). Sex-specific signal in healthy (TAC1/CA14) + blunting in FM patient neutrophils = converging pain-inflammation axis.

dataset.design: 62 FM (Case) vs 64 HC (Control), neutrophils, LPS-stimulated (NAR) vs unstimulated (NNAR)
dataset.naming_correction: NAR=LPS-stimulated (NOT unstimulated): IL1B NAR mean TPM 10,290 vs NNAR 146 - unambiguous

description: GSE334369 blunted-response FM neutrophils: paired LPS-stimulated (NAR) vs unstimulated (NNAR) TPM analysis of 19 key genes (IL1B/IL6/CXCL8/TNFAIP3 inflammasome axis, ISG15/MX1/OAS1 IFN axis, TAC1/TACR1 sensory axis, OPRM1/CA14). Completes the 2x2 FME cuadro his GSE324210 (acute exercise response).
hash_method: eidos-canonicalization-v1 (excludes spec_hash and hash_method, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False)

NO_blunting.note: Interferon axis NOT blunted in FM neutrophils

CA14.note: CA14 downregulated MORE in control - less blunted in FM

TACR1.note: small delta but significant; TACR1 signaling axis

kill_criterion.metric: at least 1 gene with blunting p<0.05 after Bonferroni correction (19 tests)
kill_criterion.result: FAIL strict (BXCL8 p=0.0096 > 0.0026); PASS exploratory (6 genes p<0.05, all in consistent direction)

multiple_testing.note: CXCL8 p=0.0096 over Bonferroni (0.0026); others nominal only. Treat as exploratory.

paired_analysis.method: log2(LPS+0.1 / UNSTIM+0.1) within-subject, Welch t-test case vs control
